name: imdb_test_pre_run_audit_v1
scope: Historical JSON and log artifacts under kafa_script/analysis_outputs, excluding the newly created imdb_server_role_reversal subtree.
interpretation: No retained pre-role-reversal experiment JSON or log referenced the IMDb test path or byte hash. This proves the retained execution-record history only; it cannot prove that no person ever viewed the dataset outside recorded artifacts.
test_byte_access_before_model_evaluation: The manifest generator and artifact audit hashed and line-counted raw test bytes without decoding JSON, text, or labels.
role_boundary: IMDb train and the sentiment task interface had already served as off-task inputs, so the experiment is an untouched-test role reversal rather than dataset-naive replication.
